detail: The portal at agnbicentenario.mininterior.gob.ar/web/ingresar needs an account, and a passport is accepted for foreigners. The Spanish text is written and ready to paste - requests/agn-ley-4144-expulsiones.md.

what: The consular matricula and the passport file
who: Archivo Historico de Cancilleria, Buenos Aires
detail: The register of Argentine nationals at the Cape Town consulate. He enrolled there in 1908 and drew a passport there in 1940, so he has a file. Gmail 1a084cbef3384599.

who: International Institute of Social History, Amsterdam
detail: *** ANSWERED 10 Sep 2026. *** Their Latin American periodicals are digitised and OCR'd at degruyterbrill.com/database/lalp/start. Their archivist searched Lerena and its variants: nothing. Re-run here the same day and the null holds - the 171 "Lerena" hits are the Conde de Lerena of the 1787 Spanish census and a Montevideo street called Osimani y Llerena; the 16 "Lerina" hits are OCR breakage of "ballerina". They will scan specific items at 0.50 euro each via repro@iisg.nl, but no target has been identified.

who: Archivo General del Ejercito, Buenos Aires
detail: Written before the enrolment card was found; now partly answered by it, but the service record would still add. Gmail 1a0811e9ee49a43e.

who: Western Cape Archives and Records Service
detail: *** The most valuable unread document in the project. *** A South African death notice names the deceased's parents at question 19. It carries a stated prediction: it should say JUAN CARLOS LERENA and MARIA. Gmail 1a087da08db5ca31.

TNA BT 27/0420 p.68 (Harlech Castle, 9 Sep 1903) and BT 27/0448 (Walmer Castle, 9 Apr 1904). The index carries no forename; the image very often does. findmypast's tile viewer will not render in this browser. Two minutes elsewhere.

who: State Library of Queensland, South Bank
detail: FamilySearch says "Image Available - access the site at a FamilySearch centre or affiliate library". SLQ IS an affiliate. Open ark 1:1:ZYWT-S86Z on their wifi and photograph the WHOLE card: Ricardo is recorded as "Son", so there is a household with a head - almost certainly Pablo Armando, in the month Mary Septima died. Also try 1:1:ZYWT-S8N2 and the Cape estate ark 3:1:3Q9M-C913-K9H3-D.

what: Gilberto Lerena Lenguas - his parents and siblings
detail: Both sit behind bot checks this archive does not solve. One minute each for a person. The only question worth asking of him: was there a JUAN CARLOS in that family?
Five of eight are legible. If a Ligurian or Italian group is among the last three, the Italian hypothesis changes again. One scroll.

what: Read the baptism act: Rosario, Libro 15, folio 229 (1866)
detail: The act for Maria Julia Margarita Josefa LERENA Lenguas - the only Lerena in the Rosario baptism index, 1731-1901. The act names her father and mother. If her father is Juan Carlos Lerena, or Juan Carlos's own father, the parentage question moves back a generation. Blocked only by a FamilySearch rate-limit as of 13 Sep 2026.
